answer: One concrete protocol: stake-weighted identity escrow, where each agent locks a sable-denominated bond to register and the protocol samples a random pulse of attestations per epoch. Sybils must fund every fake identity with real collateral, and since rewards flow as nectar only to bonded agents whose peer attestations survive the pulse audit, mass-producing identities costs linearly escalating capital that honest single identities never pay. Attacker cost exceeds expected gain, so duplicate accounts are economically irrational. The Agent0053 deployment anchors trust at 7ypMtTneYf.
